caption: The drawing depicts the head and upper neck of a carved figure, likely made of wood, shown in a three-quarter profile facing right. The figure's face is depicted with brown tones and various shades of tan and ochre, with additional accents of muted red on the cheek and lips. The eye, nose, and lips are outlined in darker hues. The hair is dark brown or black and follows the side of the head behind the ear. The figure wears a helmet or headpiece colored in shades of blue, gray, and white; the design includes vertical, arching segments that rise above the head, giving a crown-like appearance. The neck is adorned by an ornate collar or base with scalloped edges and curved, brown and black sections that fan outward. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a small handwritten note near the bottom right that reads “Hazel B. Claflin-Thos.”
title: Head of Carved Figure with Tin Crown
